reviews.x: I wear my hair braided or in a ponytail to bed and around the house all the time since i have long hair. I thought these might be a comfortable alternative and they boast they they dont leave lines and it's true! Love these!

I've owned satin scrunchies in the past and only used them when I couldn't find anything else. They'd just slide out of my hair and I'd have to constantly put it back in (and I have a ton of hair). I was wow'ed by these Kitsche scrunchies right away! Not only do they feel super smooth in your hand, they actually stay put with only two twists! It's so comfortable and pull at all when taking it out. My other scrunchies always have hairs stuck to it when I take it out but this doesn't at all!

I got the ivory ones and they are so cute! They come in a pack of 5 and I have been using them to tie my hair up at night and it's not as harsh as my regular hair ties. I also love the way they look on my wrist. It is made of very thin fabric but it has not come apart as of yet. Thank you

I love my satin scrunchies! I only bought a small amount of them because I was worried they would slip off my hair. I was so wrong! They stay in my hair until I take them out! They come out easy with zero damage to my hair. Highly recommend! I will be buying from this seller! They came fast too!

I HAVE CURLY HAIR AND THIS ACTUALLY KEEPS MY HAIR OUT OF MY FACE AND LOOKING FAB FOR 2 DAYS AFTER WASHDAY... I have never had that happen. I have looser curls 2c/3a and they always look like straight waves by day 3... I highly recommend this. I use it all the time: gym, sleep, during the day... wish the black would be restocked... or they had grey or brown... WILL BE REBUYING

There’s very little to like about these. Not stretchy enough to hold my medium weight hair on top of my hair while I sleep. I have to go around my hair four times (which is very challenging) or it slides right off my head as it isn’t right enough. I really dislike how little “silk” is in it as well. Very skimpy and already falling apart in just a couple of months.
The elastic isn’t stretchy, so wrapped around twice isn’t tight enough but it’s too rigid to go around again. Will be returning.

I wear my hair in a bun most of the week. I often wear the same bun for a day or two at a time. I have been living in these scrunchies for a couple of weeks now and I love them!! My hair isn’t getting dented like with regular hair ties. I am experiencing less hair breakage. Which is great! Not only are these on trend but they are good for your hair!

First of all, I need to be clear-- these are not a luxury item by any means.  They are made of polyester satin of medium quality-- they have a visible weave and are only really smooth to the touch in one direction, following the "grain" of the fabric. The stitching is not the best I've ever seen, and there are some loose threads. They also have what feels like plain old sewing elastic inside, not the thicker, stronger elastic you usually find in hair bands.  That said, they work perfectly well f

I love the size of these scrunchies, they aren't super fluffy and big, but aren't tiny either. I've mainly been wearing them around the house to keep my hair out of the way. I do have very thick hair that is kind of long, and these dont hold it up super well, so if I wear these scrunchies out of the house, then i tie my hair in a regular ponytail first, then put these over it for a cuter look.

For the price, these silk scrunchies are surprisingly high quality.  I use them to pull back my hair for exercise and sleeping, and (unlike elastic bands) these are gentle on my hair and do not leave a telltale "dent".  Will definitely order more.
Love the shiny satin material. Does not crimp or bend the hair. Leaves hair smooth when u take it out. I sleep with one in my hair in a high ponytail. When I wake up my hair is soft and bouncy!

Never had satin hair ties before but wanted to try because I heard it’s good for curly hairs for nighttime routine. From the reviews it seemed like a good scrunchie. However when I got them they’re smaller then the pictures and it stretches pretty good. But it didn’t do what I bought it for. I bought it to do my pineapple hair for my night time routine. And just to tie it once around my hair but it slipped off. And it said for any hair types so I’m not sure. I think I’m just going to stick to re

I have one of these scrunchies in my hair as I type this. My favorite part about these scrunchies is that they actually hold my hair. I have long/heavy hair and these aren't constantly falling down. I have several scrunchies from walmart that don't have a strong enough elastic for them to hold a high ponytail for instance, but with these, they have the stronger elasticity like a normal ponytail but the satin is WAYYYY better for your hair and for breakage (one of my biggest struggles). As a resu

I have had these scrunchies for almost 2 years, and with daily wear, they're still holding up! They're perfect for my thin, breakable hair, and easy to clean. I personally soak them in Oxi-Clean after about a month of continuous use and then use a gentle anti-acne cleanser to remove excess oil from the material, since I use them while working out, and my boyfriend usually has one in his possession. I'm sure his 3+ hour workout is what gets them the dirtiest! I'm so glad I asked for them. They're

Overall I liked these scrunchies, they aren’t the best quality but I just use them to keep hair out of my face. The grip isn’t very tight which I personally like. When I wear my hair in a high ponytail it doesn’t hurt at the end of the day as it normally does with other hair ties but it does feel like a rubber band covered in a satin fabric. The color is the same as the picture. The price isn’t bad for how many you get though. I would consider buying it again. -Lia

reviews.t: Made of 100% Polyester not the 100%  Satin Charmeuse as described in the listing.
reviews.x: The listing clearly states "100% Satin Charmeuse scrunchies slide through hair without abrasion, allowing you to wake up frizz-free and ready to take on the day! Banish breakage and conquer creases with these chic day to night no-brainers."Well it's a "No-Brainer" that these are made of 100% polyester as it is labeled on the bag. If I had wanted poly, I would of bought poly I wanted silk, real silk.

reviews.t: Middle seems are ripping but it’s OK
reviews.x: Love the scrunchies I think I’ve had them for about 2 months or so.  They do the job and they don’t leave any wrinkles in my hair which I love and it doesn’t feel like my hair is being tugged at, however after using them pretty much every day the seams in the middle are ripping.  The scrunchy it’s self has it ripped and it still holding on the well...  but if they do rip I’ll probably order more

I really like these scrunchies so far. I have medium length and fine hair... so these scrunchies really look cute when I wear them! I was afraid it would look weird if these were those large, 90s-like scrunchies, but they are really nice. My hair does get a tiny crease if I wear these for awhile throughout the day, but I attribute that to how fine my hair is.

I was worried that these scrunchies would be super slick and fall out of my hair. They actually do quite a good job holding my hair in place while I sleep. They're a little pricey for my normal buy, but I enjoy them and will use them until they stretch out. So far, they have held up well to regular wearing, and the color is pretty cute.

I am so glad I invested in these scrunchies. I have rather fine, thin hair that tends to kink/frizz overnight with the night time hot flashes. These little gems keep my hair straight and tangle free. I do have two monster cowlicks at the crown of my head that I need to flatten out in the morning, but that's it. I just love these!

I've been looking for good silk scrunchies that won't damage my hair and look great day or night. These are the perfect scrunchies and the color is spot on to wear with anything. The silk is great quality and the price is even better. I definitely recommend them for anyone who has dyed or highlighted hair :)

I have fine hair and I got these because I felt like the black elastics I was using were breaking my hair and these have been really nice in comparison. They're softer on my hair and I think I'm not having as much come out when I remove it. They also even look nice on your wrist when you have your hair down.

reviews.t: Not so great for sleeping in
reviews.x: They are okay. One of them is falling apart, the seam split, overall they just didn’t really serve their purpose for me. To sleep in them, they’re either too loose and fall out or if I poop them more they’re too tight and leave dents in my hair. They’re good for daytime use for me not so much sleeping.

These feel really soft, they have nice stretch to them but they fray a lot. When you go to put them in your hair some threads come loose and just hang around which bothers me but they are light, a little too heavy for my short/thin hair but for my sisters longer hair they're great.

claims.text: Many reviewers say these scrunchies are gentle on hair, leaving no dents or creases and reducing breakage.
Several reviewers praise how well they hold hair, including long or heavy hair, without slipping.
Some reviewers complain the elastic is not stretchy or strong enough, causing the scrunchie to slide off or be too rigid to wrap again.
Reviewers frequently mention the smooth satin material and that it is comfortable for sleeping and everyday wear.
A few reviewers note the fabric is thin or of medium polyester quality rather than a luxury item.
